info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Limits-v3-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Limits Retrieval API provides access to the limits associated with various banking accounts. This endpoint allows users to list the defined limits for individual accounts, aiding in financial planning and compliance. Typically utilized by financial institutions, accountants, and compliance officers, this API streamlines the management of account limits. Developers can leverage this functionality to integrate account limit information into financial applications and services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current limits associated with a specific account, including various thresholds and restrictions that apply. It's essential for understanding how much of a resource is available for use.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to retrieve account limits associated with the specified account. It should be formatted as a JSON object and adhere to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns account limits.
